title: Kanssa with several companions
focus: Put a plural genitive before kanssa (“with”): lasten kanssa (“with the children”).
prerequisiteSkills: Location postpositions with a singular genitive

exercises.prompt: Complete “I am with the children.” Olen ____ kanssa. Use lapsi (plural).
exercises.explanation: Use lasten before kanssa. The companion expression is a plural genitive; the speaker remains one person. Also accepted here: lapsien.

sentenceExplanation.pattern: Put a plural genitive before kanssa (“with”): lasten kanssa (“with the children”).

parts.formation: Olen is the supplied first-person singular present form of olla; it already includes “I”.
Use lasten before kanssa. The companion expression is a plural genitive; the speaker remains one person.
Put kanssa after the genitive noun or name.
